mode: read-only public website screening; no UI, external submission, credentials or master-ledger writes

history_check.result: No matches for these eight candidate domains at time of inspection.

candidates.free_evidence: Official pricing: R$ 0 per launch, five free slots daily, scheduling up to 90 days. Free backlink only if product reaches Top 3.
candidates.account: Required; Google, GitHub, Discord, or email/password.
candidates.assets: Form fields behind sign-in; current asset requirements not verified.
candidates.terms: Continue indicates acceptance of Terms and Privacy. Terms updated 2026-11-07; user retains ownership and licenses platform display/use; platform can remove content.
candidates.review_wait: Up to 90-day scheduling; no guarantee of immediate free publication.
candidates.recommendation: Do not prioritize for immediate public backlink.

candidates.free_evidence: No official free submission price or immediate-public promise verified.
candidates.assets: Submission form hidden until login; not verified.
candidates.terms: Terms license submitted content for copying/display/editing/translation and associated name publication; no obligation to publish; discretion to remove.

candidates.free_evidence: Public indexed form has no displayed fee, but an explicit first-party free pricing statement for AllStartups itself was not found. Search snippets saying free in /Startups/Listings describe other platforms.
candidates.account: Indexed official form is publicly readable without login.
candidates.assets: Name; pitch recommended around 150 and max 256 chars; URL; unique description; stage; launch date; image 1024x536 or 2048x1072, <=500 KB; platform types; contact name/email; optional social links.
candidates.terms: Startup <=5 years, own domain, English content/interface, innovative tech product (not ecommerce/blog). Proceeding means acceptance; platform may decline, edit URL/pitch/description/image, or contact submitter. Form also inconsistently asks younger than 6 years below launch date.
candidates.review_wait: Up to 60 days; unpublished after that likely declined.
candidates.reachability: Fresh public HTTPS checks on apex and www failed because TLS certificate has expired. Web fetch also timed out/502; indexed form is not proof of current browser availability. Do not bypass browser certificate warning.
candidates.recommendation: Not immediate; verify only through normal secure browser route if site certificate repaired.

candidates.free_evidence: No explicit current official submission-price or instant-public promise verified; free/paid labels on homepage describe listed tools, not directory submission fees.
candidates.account: Required; /submit/ redirects to login. Google offered, as well as username/password, GitHub and Twitter.
candidates.assets: Official FAQ: name, description, URL and related tags; showcase image, logo and pricing optional.
candidates.terms: Terms require accurate registration and rights to content; service terms include no automated/non-human access and broad rights language for contributions/submissions.
candidates.review_wait: FAQ says submitted tool appears in dashboard and email may be sent, but does not establish public visibility or timing.
candidates.recommendation: Potential account-based candidate only; no verified free immediate public route.

candidates.free_evidence: Official $0 forever plan: one directory listing and product page, no credit card or trial.
candidates.account: Required; free account includes one tool.
candidates.assets: Name, URL, tagline, description, categories and media; website prefill offered.
candidates.terms: Parent agent verified homepage free-flow requirements: upvote five community tools; one star rating and written feedback of at least two lines/20 chars; permanent badge. These are not satisfied by this read-only research. Do not invent recommendations/votes.
candidates.review_wait: Free listings typically reviewed in about four weeks. Instant Launch costs $39 one-time; Featured $49/week or $99/month.
candidates.recommendation: Exclude from immediate-free-public priority; free path has community/badge requirements and review.

candidates.terms: Terms page indexed, but no current submission checkpoint established.
candidates.reachability: Fresh public HTTPS requests to apex and www returned HTTP 500; web fetch inaccessible/timeout.
candidates.recommendation: Unavailable for current read-only verification; not counted or submitted.

candidates.free_evidence: Official current pricing has no free plan: Basic $15.90 once (displayed discount from $19.90), Featured $19.90 once, Sponsored $29.90/month. Daily free submissions apply only within paid memberships.
candidates.account: First step publicly visible; account requirement after Continue not tested.
candidates.assets: Initial form: tool name, website URL, contact email.
candidates.terms: Footer Terms/Privacy links; payment needed under current published plans.
candidates.review_wait: Basic 7 days; Featured 3 days. Refund if not approved. Basic has no badge-verification requirement.

candidates.free_evidence: No price or publication timing promise. Official Submit embeds interview application, not a direct product directory listing.
candidates.account: Public NoteForms form readable without login.
candidates.assets: Company website, name, email, interview-method preference, whether revenue may be disclosed (optional), newsletter opt-in question.
candidates.terms: Form intro requests interview and article about story/business; revenue disclosure optional, claimed to improve clicks/placement. Privacy policy linked on parent site. Required status of newsletter option not established.
candidates.review_wait: Editorial interview/article flow; no immediate publication promise.
candidates.reachability: notionforms.io official iframe redirects to noteforms.com and returned HTTP 200.
candidates.recommendation: Do not treat interview request as immediate backlink or publication receipt.
